stage: Before any successful end-to-end survey simulation or parameter-recovery outcome; engineering pilot failed at host-efficiency probability greater than one.
objective: Conditional physical injection recovery through released DES cadence, photometric noise, pipeline detection, host redshift selection, native SALT fitting, reconstructed classifier and independently trained distance correction.
truth_population: Explicit hypothetical Wiseman 2022 mocked-host SN_age population, coupled to released Nicolas width-age PDF and P23 intrinsic-colour/dust PDFs. It is a published simulation hypothesis, not ages measured from observed galaxies.

arms.nominal: Released W22 age-width and P23 dust prescription, no extra age brightness term.
arms.age: Same population plus grey magnitude -0.030*(SN_age_Gyr-3) applied before detector selection and fitting.
arms.dust: Same mocked hosts and width-age relation, with released P23sys1 dust/colour distribution substituted; report its entire physical distribution change.
arms.age_self_correction: Train a separate correction on age-injected simulated population to distinguish misspecified nominal correction from correction that includes the extra term.

sampling: Fixed generated-attempt counts, not fixed accepted-event counts. Initial engineering benchmark300 attempts. Campaign volume chosen from native runtime and support, recorded before evaluating scientific contrasts. Common-seed simulations are not assumed paired until full truth coordinates are verified.
efficiency: Primary valid efficiency model bounds released grid probabilities to[0,1] before convex multilinear interpolation with nearest-edge extrapolation. Explicit sensitivity uses min(1,max(0,interpolated original map)), mathematically equivalent to the November2025 code's uniform-Bernoulli threshold. Neither is silently equated to empirical discovery truth.
selection: Released DES pipeline efficiency and host-redshift maps, including failed attempts, native epoch/fit cuts. Reconstructed SNNV19 probability is a separate conditional selection; failed original equivalence gate remains.
correction: Run native BBC if supported; check independent train/evaluation support and report failed sparse cells. A separately labeled lower-dimensional correction may be used when production4D support is absent. Do not extrapolate unsupported cells.
uncertainty: Host/cadence block resampling with correction-training uncertainty propagated; report signed redshift response and full bin covariance. Paired noise cancellation only after verifying latent event identity.
gates: Source hashes and released model identities
Exact physical-ID joins with no truth classifier features
